command:
printf 'USB TREE
'
timeout -k 1s 4s lsusb -t
printf '
ROLE SWITCHES
'
for entry in /sys/class/usb_role/*/role /sys/class/typec/*/data_role /sys/class/dual_role_usb/*/mode; do
  [ -r "$entry" ] || continue
  printf '%s: ' "$entry"
  cat "$entry"
done
printf '
USB DEVICE ATTRIBUTES
'
for entry in /sys/bus/usb/devices/*; do
  [ -r "$entry/idVendor" ] || continue
  printf '%s ' "$entry"
  for key in idVendor idProduct product authorized; do
    [ -r "$entry/$key" ] || continue
    printf '%s=' "$key"
    cat "$entry/$key"
  done
done
printf '
UVC DRIVER
'
ls -d /sys/bus/usb/drivers/uvcvideo 2>&1
if [ -r /proc/config.gz ]; then
  zcat /proc/config.gz | grep -E 'CONFIG_USB_VIDEO_CLASS|CONFIG_USB_XHCI_HCD|CONFIG_MEDIA_USB_SUPPORT'
fi
printf '
USB KERNEL EVENTS
'
dmesg | grep -iE 'usb|xhci|uvc|over.current|descriptor' | tail -n 55
